name: Morphine
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Benzodiazepines and other CNS depressants (sedatives, antipsychotics, muscle relaxants, gabapentin, pregabalin, other opioids, alcohol)
key_interactions.effect: Hypotension, respiratory depression, profound sedation, coma and death (label boxed warning).
key_interactions.action: Reserve for patients without alternatives; use the lowest doses and shortest duration; monitor for respiratory depression and sedation.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Serotonergic drugs (SSRIs, SNRIs, tricyclics, triptans, 5-HT3 antagonists, mirtazapine, trazodone, tramadol)
key_interactions.action: Observe closely; stop morphine if serotonin syndrome is suspected.
